title: Write an unambiguous date
summary: A DATE literal names a calendar date in a fixed form.
introduction: A DATE literal names a calendar date in a fixed form. Your task: Write a date literal for the next club meeting.
learningObjectives: Write a date literal for the next club meeting.

blocks.text: A DATE literal names a calendar date in a fixed form. TO_CHAR can choose a clear display format for it.
Use Oracle Database 19c+ with a SQL editor in a new practice schema. Oracle SQL and PL/SQL do not run in this site's SQLite playground. Create only the named sample objects in that practice schema.

blocks.code: SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE '2026-11-16','YYYY-MM-DD') AS club_day FROM dual;
blocks.title: Write an unambiguous date

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `DUAL` lets this Oracle statement return a calculation without an application table.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not rely on a machine's default date format when a string could mean different dates.
